findings.issue: Mathlib dropped the apply lemma for `LieEquiv.ofBijective`. The PR proves its apply equations by unfolding: `rfl` in Lie/Quotient.lean:248 and Geometry/Lie/Functor.lean `lieEquivOfIsLocalDiffeomorphAt_apply`, a bare defeq term in Lie/SemiDirect/Basic.lean:184, and a private `toChevalleyLieLatticeEquiv_apply := rfl` in Lie/Chevalley/Semisimple.lean:287 added only so `simp` can see through it. This does not create a new normal form, as the author argues: these sites used to close via `simp [def]` and `LieEquiv.ofBijective_toFun`, so the lemma restores pre-bump behaviour. TauCeti already has the Lie-module analogue, `TauCeti.LieModuleEquiv.ofBijective_apply`, in the same Basic.lean.

summary: The `IsLattice`→`IsFullLattice` renames are done except for one public `@[simp]` lemma. Mathlib no longer has an apply lemma for `LieEquiv.ofBijective`, so this PR proves those equations by unfolding in `rfl` proofs plus a private helper instead of restoring the lemma once.
